Factory machine monitoring (OEE)

See on screen whether each machine is running, idle or down, with downtime reasons and lost hours counted. An MVP in 8–12 weeks, from UZS 144 mln; the full version in 16–30 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • 10–30 machines connected through PLCs or add-on sensors
  • Status and counters
  • Downtime reasons entered by operators
  • Shop-floor screen
What the full version adds
  • OEE per line and shift
  • Energy per unit
  • Early warning signs for maintenance
  • Links to ERP orders
  • Management reports

What we need from you

  • Site access and space for the devices
  • Internet or SIM cards
  • A budget for the hardware, which is not in the price
